import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Verified rule so far: stampable sizes (from empty-interior demo frames): 5x6, 4x3, 4x5.
# All other frames (including those in the test input: sizes 4x8, 3x6, 4x4, 2x7) keep their interiors untouched (background), border intact.
out=[r[:] for r in G['Test input']]
print(json.dumps(out))

def solve(gi):
    res=[r[:] for r in gi]
    frs=bbox_and_inner(gi)
    # find noisy frame: interior contains nonzero cells
    noisy=[f_ for f_ in frs if any(gi[f_['r0']+i+1][f_['c0']+j+1]!=0 for i in range(f_['h']-2) for j in range(f_['w']-2))]
    t=noisy[0]
    tmpl=[(i,j) for i in range(t['h']-2) for j in range(t['w']-2) if gi[t['r0']+i+1][t['c0']+j+1]!=0]
    tgt=[f_ for f_ in frs if (f_['c'],f_['inner'])==noisy[0]['c',None]]
    # careful: inner is a tuple; compare inner dims only, exclude noisy itself
    targets=[f_ for f_ in frs if f_['inner']==t['inner'] and id(f_)!=id(t)]
    erased=[f_ for f_ in frs if f_['inner']!=t['inner']]
    for f_ in targets:
        for (iy,jx) in tmpl:
            res[f_['r0']+iy+1][f_['c0']+jx+1]=f_['c']
    for f_ in erased:
        for y in range(f_['r0'],f_['r1']+1):
            for x in range(f_['c0'],f_['c1']+1):
                res[y][x]=0
    return res
